newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nagasakiya says to liquidate unit.
newsitem.headline: Nagasakiya says to liquidate unit.

text.p: Japanese supermarket operator Nagasakiya Co Ltd said on Friday that it would liquidate one of its subsidiaries, but added that the liquidation would not affect its profits forecast for the current business year.

Nagasakiya will liquidate the wholly owned unit, an amusement park operator in northern Japan, at the end of February 1997 as the unit is posting losses due to the unexpectedly small number of visitors to the amusement park, Nagasakiya said in a statement.

The planned liquidation would lead to a loss of about 13 billion yen, but Nagasakiya expects a profit of nine billion yen from sales of shareholdings to partly cover the loss. The rest of the loss will be covered by loan loss reserves, the company said.
Nagasakiya said it would maintain its October forecast of a parent current profit of two billion yen and net profit of 500 million yen in the year to February 28, 1997.
The company posted a parent current profit of 306 million yen and net loss of 22.83 billion yen in the year-earlier period.
